name: scopedeadline
algorithm: n rounds of the library's per-operation deadline of one second, which never fires, split evenly over t tasks or goroutines (Mk: a scope with Scope.CancelAfter, then the scope's exit, whose Join disarms it, D8-3; Go: context.WithTimeout, ctx.Err() and cancel). Task k runs rounds i = k m .. k m + m - 1 (m = n / t) and updates x = x * 31 + i, wrapping; prints n, t, the wrapping sum of the tasks' x and the rounds that expired (0). Variants t1 to t16 set t to 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 on 16 threads. M9 item 7.16 (G-RT8-R5, D-817): the aggregate throughput of Mk's t16 cell is at least that of its t1 cell, that is t16's time is at most t1's for the same n (README.md).

skip.c: not written: C has no scopes or per-operation deadlines; its form would be a timer wheel or heap the program writes itself, not a library call as the other cells are
skip.rust: not written: Rust's std has no per-operation deadline outside a socket's set_read_timeout, which is a system call and not a timer; tokio::time::timeout is a third-party crate
skip.zig: not written: Zig 0.17's std.Io has no deadline attached to a group of operations; its form would be a select over the work and a sleep future, which is not one library call as the other cells are

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; the sum checks that every task ran all of its rounds in order
notes: M9 item 7.16's row (G-RT8-R5, D-817): before D-817 every deadline in the process went through one timer heap behind one lock (std/task/timer.mk's tlock), so tasks arming deadlines on different carriers contended on it; with D-817 each carrier has its own heap and lock. No number is recorded here: the throughput bar (t16 at least t1) is owed to a tools/bench publish on a quiet machine, on both targets.

Checksums from a Go model (x = 31 x + i over each task's rounds, wrapping, summed over the tasks) and each column's quick verify run (lane K, 2026-11-15). The publish size is a guess until tools/bench publish times the row on a quiet machine.
Written by M9 lane K (item 7.16); plan/09-deferred.md 7.16 records what was checked.
